profile_text.body:
OpenAI is a for-profit startup founded in 2015 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. Its website centers on ChatGPT, which the company describes as a tool for answering questions, writing, creating images, completing work, and coding in one place, available free or through a downloadable app. The site also states that chats may be reviewed and used to improve its AI models.

The company's tracked products span several categories. ChatGPT is listed as a general LLM assistant, alongside the OpenAI API and GPT models, the OpenAI Playground and Dashboard for API testing, fine-tuning, usage tracking, and team management, and Operator, described as an autonomous web agent with browser control. Image, video, and audio products include DALL-E for image generation, Sora for video generation, and the Whisper API for speech recognition, transcription, and translation.

OpenAI appears in a substantial body of litigation. Named cases include Vredenburgh v. OpenAI OpCo, LLC and Craddock v. OpenAi OpCo LLC in the District Court, N.D. California, wikiHow, Inc. v. OpenAI, Inc. in the S.D. New York, United States v. OpenAI OpCo LLC in the E.D. Arkansas, Many Worlds 2T Innovations LLC v. OpenAI OpCo, LLC in the E.D. Texas, Morales v. OpenAI Foundation and Gourley v. OPENAI FOUNDATION in the N.D. Florida, Haugland v. OpenAI, Inc. in the D. Hawaii, Starr v. OpenAI Group PBC, Mall v. OPENAI FOUNDATION f/k/a OpenAI, Inc., and X.AI Corp., et al. v. OpenAI, Inc., et al. before the Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit. Its recorded law exposure is concentrated in California, with 281 matters there. MCP servers listed under its name include ai.com.mcp/openai-tools, described as a focused server for OpenAI image and audio generation, and several agent entries such as ai.getvda/authenticated-mcp-agent-openai, ai.getvda/llm-orchestration-agent-openai, and ai.getvda/structured-output-agent-openai.
